title: Zuora Workflow Schema Manifest
description: Bundled manifest of all workflow task and workflow-level JSON schemas. Auto-generated by rails/script/generate_schema_manifest.py — do not edit manually.

_common_task_parameters.title: Common Task Parameters
_common_task_parameters.description: Common parameters available on all task types. These parameters control variable validation, workflow setup validation, task categorization, and payload cleanup.

strict_variables.description: When true, undefined Liquid variables in task parameters cause task execution failure. When false, undefined variables are treated as empty strings and execution continues.

disable_validation.description: When true, skips parameter and template validation during workflow setup. Use only for advanced cases where validation is too restrictive. Does not skip runtime validation.

delete_payload_paths.description: JSON paths to remove from workflow Data after task execution. Paths use dot notation (e.g., 'TempData.Internal', 'Query.RawResponse'). Useful for cleaning up sensitive data or intermediate results. Empty array (default) means no deletion.

approval.title: Approval Task
approval.description: Pauses workflow for human approval. Supports multiple delivery methods: Zuora inbox, email, Slack, Teams, Webex. Result stored at Data.Approval with action ('approve'/'reject'), user, and optional data. Expires after 3 months.

delivery_method.description: Delivery method for approval notifications. Controls which parameter set is required.

zuoraInbox.description: Zuora inbox configuration for zuoraInbox delivery method.

approver_emails.description: Email addresses or Zuora usernames of users who can approve. Supports Liquid templating.

slackEndpoint.description: Slack API endpoint URL. Optional for slack delivery method.

slackToken.description: Slack bot token for authentication. Store in GlobalConstants or Credentials for security. Required when delivery_method='slack'.

slackBody.description: Slack message content. Supports Liquid templating and Slack markdown. Required when delivery_method='slack'.

webexEndpoint.description: Webex API endpoint URL. Optional for webex delivery method.

webexToken.description: Webex bot token for authentication. Required when delivery_method='webex'.

webexBody.description: Webex message content. Supports Liquid templating. Required when delivery_method='webex'.

teamsTenantId.description: Microsoft 365 tenant ID for Teams authentication. Optional for teams delivery method.

teamsClientId.description: Azure AD application client ID for Teams. Required when delivery_method='teams'.

teamsClientSecret.description: Azure AD application client secret for Teams. Required when delivery_method='teams'.

teamsUsername.description: Teams sender username. Required when delivery_method='teams'.

teamsPassword.description: Teams sender password. Required when delivery_method='teams'.

teamsBody.description: Teams message content. Supports Liquid templating. Required when delivery_method='teams'.

senderEmail.description: Sender email address for email delivery method. Required when delivery_method='email'.

subjectEmail.description: Email subject line for email delivery method. Supports Liquid templating. Required when delivery_method='email'.

emailBody.description: Email body HTML content for email delivery method. Supports Liquid templating. Required when delivery_method='email'.

rejecter.description: User who can reject the approval.

approver.description: Specific user who can approve the request.

selected_approvers.description: JSON string of selected approver objects for business process workflows.

approvalNote.description: Message explaining what needs approval. Displayed in all delivery methods. Supports Liquid templating.

slack_approver_emails.description: Email addresses of Slack users for slack delivery method.

webex_approver_emails.description: Email addresses of Webex users for webex delivery method.

teams_approver_emails.description: Email addresses of Teams users for teams delivery method.

email_approver_emails.description: Email addresses for email delivery method.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Approval`` for this schema.

asynchronous_callout.title: Asynchronous Callout Task
asynchronous_callout.description: Fires an initial HTTP callout then polls a follow-up endpoint until finish_status is matched in response_path or retries are exhausted. Initial request params match Callout; polling params use polling_ prefix. Response stored at Data.<payload_location> from validation settings.

polling_url.description: URL for the polling follow-up request. Supports Liquid templating.

polling_body_type.description: Request body type for polling requests.

polling_raw_body.description: Request body when polling_body_type is 'raw'. Supports Liquid.

polling_file_binary.description: File key in Data.Files for binary polling upload.

polling_authorization.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingAuthorization
polling_authorization.description: Authentication for polling requests. Uses the same auth type vocabulary as the initial Callout request, including saved_provider:<uuid>.

oneOf.description: Manual authentication method for polling requests.
Reference to a saved authentication provider from Settings → Authentication Providers. Format: saved_provider:<provider_id>. Credentials are loaded at runtime.

polling_type.description: Polling authentication method. Manual types require matching polling credential namespaces. saved_provider:<uuid> loads credentials from Settings at runtime.

username.description: Username for polling basic_auth (legacy; prefer polling_basic_auth namespace).

password.description: Password for polling basic_auth (legacy; prefer polling_basic_auth namespace).

polling_basic_auth.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingBasicAuth
polling_basic_auth.description: Basic auth credentials for polling. Required when polling_authorization.polling_type is 'basic_auth'. Omit when using saved_provider.

polling_oauth2.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingOauth2
polling_oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration for polling. Omit when using saved_provider.

polling_oauth1.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingOauth1
polling_oauth1.description: OAuth 1.0 configuration for polling. Omit when using saved_provider.

polling_netsuite_tba.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingNetsuiteTba
polling_netsuite_tba.description: NetSuite TBA configuration for polling. Omit when using saved_provider.

polling_hmac.title: AsynchronousCalloutPollingHmac
polling_hmac.description: HMAC configuration for polling. Omit when using saved_provider.

finish_status.description: Status values indicating polling completion. Checked against response_path in polling response.

response_path.description: JSON path extracted from polling response to compare against finish_status.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``AsynchronousCallout`` for this schema.

attachment.title: Attachment Task
attachment.description: Attaches files from workflow Data.Files to Zuora business objects (Account, Invoice, etc.) via REST API. Result stored at Data.Attachment.

object.description: The Zuora business object type to attach files to.

object_id.description: ID of the object to attach files to. Supports Liquid templating.

description.description: Description/note for the attachment. Supports Liquid templating. Stored as attachment metadata.

files.description: Map of files to attach. Keys are filenames from Data.Files. Each file has 'name' (display name) and 'upload' ('true'/'false'). IMPORTANT: At least 1 file must be selected (checked at server during setup validation).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Attachment`` for this schema.

billing/bill_run.title: Billing Bill Run Task
billing/bill_run.description: Executes a bill run to generate invoices for accounts. Supports single account, ad-hoc batch, and replicate modes. Polls for completion and optionally auto-posts invoices. Results stored in Data.BillRun.

BillRunMode.description: Bill run mode. 'single' for one account, 'adhoc' for batch/BCD filtering, 'replicate' to copy settings from existing bill run.

AccountId.description: Account ID to bill (required for 'single' mode). Supports Liquid templates.

SubscriptionIds.description: Comma-separated subscription IDs to bill (single mode only). If blank, bills all subscriptions on account.

SourceBillRunId.description: Bill run ID or number to replicate (required for 'replicate' mode). Supports Liquid templates.

InvoiceDate.description: Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for single/adhoc modes. Supports Liquid templates.

TargetDate.description: Target date for billing through (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for single/adhoc modes. Supports Liquid templates.

Batch.description: Batch filter for adhoc mode. 'AllBatches' or specific batch name.

BillCycleDay.description: Bill cycle day filter for adhoc mode. 'AllBillCycleDays' or specific day (1-31).

AutoPost.description: When true, automatically posts invoices after generation.

AutoEmail.description: When true, automatically emails invoices to customers.

AutoRenewal.description: When true, automatically renews subscriptions during billing.

NoEmailForZeroAmountInvoice.description: When true, suppresses email for zero-amount invoices.

ChargeTypeToExclude.description: Charge types to exclude from billing (e.g., ['OneTime', 'Recurring', 'Usage']).

BillRunApi.description: API endpoint to use. 'v1/bill-runs' supports subscription filtering.

poll_time.description: Maximum poll time in units of 4 hours (e.g., 8 = 32 hours max). Task polls every 2 minutes.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Billing::BillRun`` for this schema.

billing/currency_conversion.title: Billing Currency Conversion Task
billing/currency_conversion.description: Converts currency amounts using OANDA exchange rates. Fetches historical rates and applies conversion to specified fields. Results stored in Data.CurrencyConversion.

currency_vendor.description: Exchange rate provider. Currently only OANDA is supported.

oauth.description: OANDA API OAuth token for authentication.

source_currency.description: Source currency code (e.g., USD, EUR). Supports Liquid templates.

target_currency.description: Target currency code to convert to. Supports Liquid templates.

date.description: Date for exchange rate lookup (YYYY-MM-DD format). Supports Liquid templates.

date_offset.description: Number of days to subtract from date for rate lookup. Supports Liquid templates.

currency_fields.title: BillingCurrencyConversionTaskCurrencyfields
currency_fields.description: Map of output field names to Liquid expressions for amounts to convert. Example: { 'ConvertedAmount': '{{ Data.Invoice.Amount }}' }

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Billing::CurrencyConversion`` for this schema.

billing/custom_billing_document.title: Billing Custom Document Task
billing/custom_billing_document.description: Generates custom PDF billing documents (invoices, credit memos, debit memos) from HTML templates. Optionally preloads related Zuora data, attaches PDF to document, and emails to recipients. Extends File::CustomPDF functionality for billing documents.

object_id.description: Billing document ID (Invoice, CreditMemo, or DebitMemo). 32-character hex format. Supports Liquid templates.

document_type.description: Type of billing document to generate PDF for. Determines which Zuora object to fetch and attach PDF to.

template.description: HTML template for PDF content. Supports Liquid templates. When preload_data=true, has access to Invoice, Account, InvoiceItem, etc.

advanced.title: BillingCustomDocumentTaskAdvanced
advanced.description: Advanced PDF generation settings: paper size, margins, headers/footers, output formats.

header_template.description: HTML template for repeating page header. Supports Liquid. Use for logo, page numbers.

footer_template.description: HTML template for repeating page footer. Supports Liquid.

skip_pdf_generate.description: When true, generates HTML file only without PDF conversion. Useful for debugging templates.

generate_docx.description: When true, generates DOCX file in addition to PDF.

preload_data.description: When true, automatically queries and loads related data: Invoice/CreditMemo/DebitMemo, Account, BillToContact, SoldToContact, Subscription, RatePlan, RatePlanCharge, Product, ProductRatePlan, ProductRatePlanCharge, InvoiceItem, TaxationItem, Usage. Max 200 records per object type.

email_invoice.description: When true, emails the generated PDF after attaching to document. Requires email_address to be set.

email_address.description: Email addresses to send PDF to when email_invoice=true. Supports Liquid templates in array items.

email_additional_email.description: When true, includes contact's AdditionalEmailAddresses field in recipients.

use_email_template.description: When true, uses tenant's configured invoice email template for email body/subject.

query_options.description: Query customizations for data preload. Options: 'include_zero_dollar_items' to include $0 line items.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Billing::CustomBillingDocument`` for this schema.

billing/reverse_invoice.title: Billing Reverse Invoice Task
billing/reverse_invoice.description: Reverses an invoice by creating a credit memo. Only available in tenants with Invoice Settlement enabled. Creates a credit memo that offsets the invoice balance. Results stored in Data.ReverseInvoiceCreditMemo.

object_id.description: Invoice ID to reverse. Supports Liquid templates.

memo_date.description: Credit memo date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current date if not specified. Supports Liquid templates.

apply_effective_date.description: Effective date for applying the credit memo (YYYY-MM-DD). Supports Liquid templates.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Billing::ReverseInvoice`` for this schema.

callout.title: Callout Task
callout.description: Makes HTTP requests to Zuora APIs or external endpoints. Supports REST methods, authentication, retries, response validation, and polling. Response stored in Data.Callout or custom location.

url.description: The URL to call. Can be a Zuora API endpoint or external URL. Supports Liquid templating for dynamic URLs.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include in the request. Supports Liquid templating in values.

api_name.description: Name for the API call (for logging/tracking in notification history).

raw_body.description: Request body when body_type is 'raw'. Use Liquid templating to build dynamic JSON payloads.

body_type.description: Type of request body. 'raw' for JSON/text, 'binary' for file uploads from Data.Files, 'form-data' for multipart forms, 'none' for no body.

form_datas.description: Form data fields when body_type is 'form-data'. Set upload=true for file uploads from Data.Files.

datas.description: Key-value data parameters for the request. Added as query params for GET or form fields for POST.

zuora_call.description: When true, indicates Zuora API call. Uses bearer token auth and handles Zuora-specific errors.

status_codes.description: HTTP status codes considered successful. Task fails if response code not in list.

replace.description: When true, replaces existing Data at payload_location instead of appending to array.

payload_location.description: Key name for storing response in Data object. Response stored at Data.<payload_location>. Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

api_doc_url.description: URL to API documentation for reference (informational only).

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts on failure (0-10). RECOMMENDED: Use 3 for external integrations.

on_timeout.description: When true, automatically retries on timeout failures.

authorization.title: CalloutTaskAuthorization
authorization.description: Authentication configuration. Use manual auth types with credential namespaces below, or saved_provider:<uuid> to reference a provider from Settings → Authentication Providers.

oneOf.description: Manual authentication method. 'zuora' uses tenant credentials. Other types require the matching credential namespace in task parameters.

Reference to a saved authentication provider from Settings → Authentication Providers. Format: saved_provider:<provider_id>. Credentials are loaded at runtime. List providers via GET /api/v1/auth_providers.

type.description: Authentication method. Manual types require matching credential namespace. saved_provider:<uuid> loads credentials from Settings at runtime.

basic_auth.title: CalloutTaskBasicAuth
basic_auth.description: Basic auth credentials. Required when authorization.type is 'basic_auth'. Omit when using saved_provider.

oauth2.title: CalloutTaskOauth2
oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration. Required when authorization.type is 'oauth_2.0'. Omit when using saved_provider.

oauth1.title: CalloutTaskOauth1
oauth1.description: OAuth 1.0 configuration. Required when authorization.type is 'oauth_1.0'. Omit when using saved_provider.

netsuite_tba.title: CalloutTaskNetsuiteTba
netsuite_tba.description: NetSuite Token-Based Authentication. Required when authorization.type is 'NetsuiteTBA'. Omit when using saved_provider.

hmac.title: CalloutTaskHmac
hmac.description: HMAC signing configuration. Required when authorization.type is 'hmac'. Omit when using saved_provider.

finish_status.description: For polling mode: status values that indicate job completion. Checked against response_path value.

response_path.description: JSON path to extract from response. For polling, this path is checked against finish_status values.

enable_polling.description: When true, enables polling mode. Task repeats until finish_status matched in response_path or max attempts reached.

polling_interval.description: Seconds between polling attempts when enable_polling is true.

polling_skip_ssl_cert_verification.description: When true, skips SSL certificate verification for polling requests.

validate_response.description: When true, validates response against validation_scheme.

validation_scheme.description: JSON schema or validation rules for response validation when validate_response is true.

include_response_code.description: When true, includes HTTP status code in output at Data.<payload_location>.ResponseCode.

notification_history_enabled.description: When true, logs callout to Zuora notification history for audit trail.

notification_history_account_id.description: Account ID for notification history logging (UUID or 32-char Zuora ID). Required when notification_history_enabled is true.

notification_history_object_id.description: Object ID for notification history logging (exactly 32 characters).

event_name.description: Event name for notification history logging.

skip_ssl_cert_verification.description: When true, skips SSL certificate verification for the request.

force_new_token.description: When true, forces generation of a new authentication token.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Callout`` for this schema.

cancel.title: Cancel Task
cancel.description: Cancels a Zuora subscription using the Amendment API. Supports both SOAP and REST. Output stored at Data.Subscription, Data.Amendment, and optionally Data.Invoice and Data.Payment.

object.description: The Zuora business object type. Use 'Subscription' for cancel operations.

object_id.description: ID of the subscription to cancel. Supports Liquid templating.

call_type.description: API type to use. REST provides additional response fields (CreditMemoId, CancelledDate).

fields.title: CancelTaskFields
fields.description: Amendment fields for cancellation. Structure varies by API type.

cancellationEffectiveDate.description: Specific cancellation date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when cancellationPolicy='SpecificDate'. Supports Liquid.

ContractEffectiveDate.description: Contract effective date for the amendment (YYYY-MM-DD). Supports Liquid.

options.title: CancelTaskOptions
options.description: Processing options for billing and payments.

ApplyCreditBalance.description: Apply available credit balance to charges.

invoiceTargetDate.description: Target date for invoice generation (YYYY-MM-DD). Supports Liquid.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Cancel`` for this schema.

create.title: Create Task
create.description: Creates a new Zuora business object record via SOAP API. The created record (including generated Id) is stored in Data.<object>.

object.description: The Zuora object type to create. Must match a valid Zuora SOAP API object name.

fields.title: CreateTaskFields
fields.description: Fields to set on the new record. Structure: {"<ObjectName>": {"<FieldName>": "<Value>"}}. ObjectName must match the object property. Values support Liquid templating. IMPORTANT: At least 1 field must be selected in parameters.fields[ObjectName] (checked at server during setup validation).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Create`` for this schema.

custom_object/create.title: Custom Object Create Task
custom_object/create.description: Creates a new custom object record in Zuora. Validates required fields against object schema and applies type coercion. Created record stored in Data.<object> with generated Id.

object.description: Custom object API name to create record in.

fields.title: CustomObjectCreateTaskFields
fields.description: Field values for the new record. Nested under object name: { 'object_name': { 'Field__c': 'value' } }. Supports Liquid templates. Must contain at least 1 field.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``CustomObject::Create`` for this schema.

custom_object/delete.title: Custom Object Delete Task
custom_object/delete.description: Deletes a custom object record from Zuora. Also removes the record from workflow Data if present. Supports both single records and array cleanup. Deletion is permanent.

object.description: Custom object API name containing the record to delete. Must be valid custom object with 'default__' or namespace prefix.

object_id.description: UUID of the record to delete. Must be valid UUID format (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). Supports Liquid templates.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``CustomObject::Delete`` for this schema.

custom_object/query.title: Custom Object Query Task
custom_object/query.description: Queries custom object records using Zuora's custom object API. Supports query expressions or direct ID filtering. Returns array of matching records in Data.<object> or Data.<alternate_location>.

object.description: Custom object API name (e.g., 'default__CustomConfig' or 'com_zuora__CustomData').

query.description: Filter query expression. Supports field comparisons and logical operators. Supports Liquid templates.

ids.description: Direct ID filter as query parameter string. Alternative to query for specific records. Supports Liquid templates.

alternate_location.description: Custom placement for results instead of object name. Useful when querying same object multiple times.

zero_result_stop.description: When true, stops workflow (no Success linkage) if query returns zero records.

fields.title: CustomObjectQueryTaskFields
fields.description: Field selection for the query results.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``CustomObject::Query`` for this schema.

custom_object/update.title: Custom Object Update Task
custom_object/update.description: Updates an existing custom object record in Zuora. Validates field existence against schema and applies type coercion. Uses PATCH method for partial updates. Updated record stored in Data.<object>.

object.description: Custom object API name containing the record to update. Must be valid custom object with 'default__' or namespace prefix.

object_id.description: UUID of the record to update. Must be valid UUID format (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). Supports Liquid templates.

fields.title: CustomObjectUpdateTaskFields
fields.description: Field values to update. Structure: { 'object_name': { 'Field__c': 'value' } }. Only specified fields are updated; others unchanged. Supports Liquid templates in values. Must contain at least 1 field.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``CustomObject::Update`` for this schema.

data/aqua.title: Data AQuA Task
data/aqua.description: Executes AQuA (Advanced Query API) queries against Zuora data. Supports ZOQL export queries with related object joins, aggregate functions, and export file generation. Results stored in Data.AQuA.<object> and Data.Files.

object.description: Primary Zuora object to query (e.g., Account, Subscription, Invoice). Related objects are automatically available for joins.

fields.title: DataAquaTaskFields
fields.description: Field selection map. Structure: { 'ObjectName': { 'FieldName': { 'value': 'true'|'Max'|'Min'|'Count'|'Average'|'Sum', 'column': int, 'order': int } } }. Aggregate functions available for numeric fields.

where_clause.description: ZOQL WHERE clause (without 'WHERE' keyword). Supports Liquid templates. Example: Account.Status = 'Active' AND {{ Data.QueryTask.FilterField }} = '{{ Data.QueryTask.FilterValue }}'

encrypt.description: When true, encrypts output file with PGP.

use_query_labels.description: When true, uses field labels instead of API names in column headers.

datetime_utc.description: When true, datetime fields are in UTC. When false, uses tenant timezone.

delay.description: Initial delay in seconds before starting the query (0-60). Helps reduce API contention.

partner.description: Partner name for AQuA job tracking. Supports Liquid templates.

project.description: Project name for AQuA job tracking. Supports Liquid templates.

convert_to_currencies.description: Currency codes to convert amounts to (e.g., ['USD', 'EUR']).

zero_result_stop.description: When true, stops workflow (no Success linkage) if query returns zero records.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Data::Aqua`` for this schema.

data/billing_preview_run.title: Data Billing Preview Run Task
data/billing_preview_run.description: Executes a billing preview run to simulate invoice generation without creating actual invoices. Generates CSV file with preview results showing what invoices would be created. Results stored in Data.BillingPreviewRun and Data.Files.

TargetDate.description: Target date for billing preview (YYYY-MM-DD). Simulates invoices that would be generated up to this date. Supports Liquid templates.

AssumeRenewal.description: How to handle subscription renewals in preview. 'None' excludes renewals, 'Autorenew' includes auto-renewing subscriptions, 'All' assumes all subscriptions renew.

Batch.description: Batch filter to limit accounts. 'Batch1' through 'Batch50' for batched accounts, 'Batch51' for accounts with no batch assigned. Supports Liquid templates.

ChargeTypeToExclude.description: Charge types to exclude from preview. Options: 'OneTime', 'Recurring', 'Usage'.

IncludeEvergreen.description: When true, includes evergreen (no end date) subscriptions in preview.

storageOption.description: Where to store results. 'Database' stores in Zuora (viewable in UI), 'File' creates downloadable CSV in Data.Files. Use 'File' for workflow processing.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Data::BillingPreviewRun`` for this schema.

data/link.title: Data Query Task
data/link.description: SQL-like queries with full JOIN support against Zuora data. Best for: complex multi-object queries, JOINs, large datasets. BATCH mode only in production (async). Unlimited records via file output. Supports live/datahub/warehouse modes. Output: Data.LinkRun + Data.Files (async) or Data.LinkData array (sync, non-prod only, max 2000). Follow with Iterate (file mode) to process rows.

query.description: SQL-like query using Zuora Data Query syntax. Supports Liquid templates. Example: SELECT Account.Name, Subscription.Status FROM Subscription WHERE Subscription.TermEndDate >= '{{ Data.Workflow.ExecutionDate }}'

file_format.description: Output file format. CSV is recommended for iteration. JSON formats return data to Data.LinkRun array (up to 200 records) or as file.

delimiter.description: Custom delimiter character for DSV format. Must be exactly 1 character.

compressed.description: When true, compresses output file as ZIP. Set to false for easier iteration. JSON formats are always compressed.

synchronous.description: When true, runs query synchronously with results in Data.LinkData (max 2000 records). Only available in non-production tenants.

mode.description: Data source mode. 'live' queries production data, 'datahub' uses Data Hub (unlimited), 'warehouse' uses Data Warehouse (requires enablement).

index_join.description: When true, enables index join optimization for queries.

read_deleted.description: When true, includes soft-deleted records in query results.

polling_interval.description: Interval in seconds between status checks (1-60).

zero_result_stop.description: When true, stops workflow (no Success linkage) if query returns zero records.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Data::Link`` for this schema.

data/warehouse.title: Data Warehouse Task
data/warehouse.description: Queries Zuora Data Warehouse for analytics and reporting. Batch mode only - runs asynchronous queries against the data warehouse layer.

query.description: SQL query to execute against the data warehouse. Supports Liquid templates. Server-side validation: parsed as valid SQL; SELECT statement only (no DML). Batch mode: asynchronous execution.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Data::Warehouse`` for this schema.

delay.title: Delay Task
delay.description: Pauses workflow execution for a specified duration or until a specific datetime. Maximum delay is 30 days. Useful for rate limiting, scheduling, or waiting for external processes.

delay_time.description: Delay duration. Options: (1) Number of seconds as string (e.g., '3600'), (2) ISO datetime string to wait until (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:00:00'), (3) Liquid expression resolving to either. Maximum 30 days. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) is interpreted in UTC unless timezone is specified.

blocking.description: When true, blocks the workflow thread during delay (synchronous wait). When false (default), releases thread and re-enqueues task after delay (async, more efficient for long delays).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Delay`` for this schema.

delete.title: Delete Task
delete.description: Deletes a Zuora business object record via SOAP API. Removes the record from Zuora and from Data.<object> if present. Deletion is permanent.

object.description: The Zuora object type to delete. Not all objects support deletion - check Zuora API documentation.

object_id.description: ID of the record to delete. Supports Liquid templating.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Delete`` for this schema.

download/s3.title: Download S3 Task
download/s3.description: Downloads files from S3 matching a path pattern. Output stored at Data.Files and Data.S3Download.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Download::S3`` for this schema.

s3_provider_id.description: Required. Saved S3 authentication provider ID from Settings → Authentication Providers. Must reference an active provider with auth_type 's3'. List available providers via GET /api/v1/auth_providers (metadata only). Inline AWS credentials are not supported.

path_pattern.description: S3 path pattern with wildcards (e.g. data/2024/report-*.csv). Supports Liquid.

destination_path.description: Move files to this folder after download. Supports Liquid.

new_filename.description: Rename files after download. Supports Liquid.

no_file_action.description: Behavior when no matching files found.

download/sftp.title: Download SFTP Task
download/sftp.description: Downloads files from a remote SFTP server. Supports glob patterns for file matching, case-insensitive matching, and post-download actions (move/delete). Output stored at Data.Files and Data.SFTPDownload.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Download::SFTP`` for this schema.

host.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address. Supports Liquid templating.

credentials.title: DownloadSftpTaskCredentials
credentials.description: Authentication credentials. Use either password (basic auth) or private_key (key-based auth).

private_key.description: SSH private key content (PEM format). Store in GlobalConstants. Supports Liquid. Required when authorization.type is 'key_based'.

passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private_key (if encrypted). Only used with key_based authentication. Store in GlobalConstants. Supports Liquid.

authorization.title: DownloadSftpTaskAuthorization
authorization.description: Authentication method selection. 'basic' uses username+password. 'key_based' uses username+private_key (with optional passphrase).

type.description: Authentication type. 'basic' for password authentication, 'key_based' for SSH private key authentication.

folder_path.description: Remote directory to search for files. Supports Liquid templating.

file_path.description: File name or glob pattern to match. Supports wildcards (* and ?). First matching file is downloaded.

case_insensitive.description: When true, file matching is case-insensitive (e.g., '*.CSV' matches 'report.csv').

halt_no_file.description: When true, task succeeds silently if no matching file found (no error). When false, throws error if no file found.

post_processing_actions.description: Action to perform on remote file after successful download. Empty = leave file in place.

new_file_path.description: Destination path for move_file action. Supports Liquid with special variables: OriginalFilePath, OriginalDirectory, OriginalFileName.

DeleteFile.description: Legacy parameter. When true, deletes remote file after download. Prefer post_processing_actions='delete_file'.

email.title: Email Task
email.description: Sends emails with support for Liquid templating in all fields, HTML content, and file attachments from workflow data. Output stored at Data.Email.

email.title: EmailTaskEmail
email.description: Email configuration including recipients, content, and attachments.

to.description: Recipient email addresses. Supports Liquid templating for dynamic recipients.

cc.description: CC email addresses. Supports Liquid templating.

bcc.description: BCC email addresses. Supports Liquid templating.

from.description: Sender email address. Must be a verified sender in your email configuration.

name.description: Display name shown as the sender. Supports Liquid templating.

subject.description: Email subject line. Supports Liquid templating for dynamic content.

reply_to.description: Reply-to email address. If empty, replies go to 'from' address.

template.description: Email body content. Supports HTML markup and Liquid templating for dynamic content.

file_ids.description: File names from Data.Files to attach. Reference files from Export, CustomPDF, SFTP Download, etc.

invoices.description: When true, attaches invoice PDFs from Data.Invoice.

return_path.description: Return path address for bounced emails. Used for bounce handling.

preview_only.description: When true, generates email preview without sending. Useful for testing workflows.

disable_editor.description: When true, disables the visual WYSIWYG email editor in workflow UI. Use for raw HTML templates.

notification_history_enabled.description: When true, logs email to Zuora notification history for tracking and auditing.

notification_history_account_id.description: Account ID for notification history logging (UUID or 32-char Zuora ID). Required when notification_history_enabled is true.

notification_history_object_id.description: Object ID for notification history logging (exactly 32 characters).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Email`` for this schema.

execute/workflow_task.title: Execute Workflow Task
execute/workflow_task.description: Executes another workflow as a sub-workflow. Can run synchronously with polling or asynchronously (fire-and-forget). Passes files and parameters to the target workflow. Results stored in Data.<placement>.

workflow_id.description: ID of the workflow to execute. Supports Liquid templates.

workflow_name.description: Name of the workflow to execute (used if workflow_id not found). Must be unique - fails if multiple workflows share the name.

enable_polling.description: When true, waits for sub-workflow completion and returns its response. Requires target workflow to have a Logic::ResponseFormatter task.

target_workflow_response.description: When polling enabled, determines which task's output to return. 'last_response_formatter' requires ResponseFormatter task.

advanced_mode.description: When true, uses raw_body JSON for parameters instead of field mapping.

raw_body.description: JSON object with workflow input parameters (when advanced_mode=true). Keys map to workflow callout_id fields. Supports Liquid templates.

fields.description: Field mappings for workflow input parameters. Maps parent workflow data to sub-workflow input fields.

placement.description: Object name in Data where output is stored.

replace_payload.description: When true, replaces existing data at placement path.

include_response_code.description: When true, wraps response in object with URL, RequestBody, ResponseCode, ResponseBody, ResponseHeaders.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Execute::WorkflowTask`` for this schema.

export.title: Export Task
export.description: Exports Zuora data to CSV files using Export ZOQL. BATCH / async only (NOT available in REALTIME / UIACTION). Unlimited records. Supports capabilities Query cannot: ORDER BY, GROUP BY (max 5 fields), HAVING, aggregate functions (Sum, Count, Max, Min, Average), relative dates (today, now - 7), and ZOQL field paths for 1:1 / N:1 joins (Invoice.Account.Name, Invoice.Account.BillToContact.WorkEmail). Output: Data.Export.<object> (metadata) + Data.Files (file). Downstream Iterate auto-resolves the CSV filename. Where clause order: filter conditions, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT (must be in this order). PREFER Export for polling / unknown volume, run-completion results (filter by SourceId = '{{Data.<RunObject>.ID}}'), reporting / aggregations, time-based queries, bulk operations. Prefer Query for specific record by ID, REALTIME / UIACTION workflows, per-record child lookups inside an Iterate. Prefer Data::Link when a JOIN across multiple objects is required. Prefer GraphQuery for a single record with nested related objects. For the full data-retrieval decision matrix call lookup_workflow_reference(topic='data_retrieval').

object.description: The Zuora data source or business object to export. MUST be a single object (no joins) and the lowest-level object in the relationship hierarchy (e.g., use 'InvoiceItem' instead of 'Invoice' if exporting item-level data).

call_type.description: API type to use for the export. Export only uses SOAP

zip.description: When true, compresses the export file as ZIP. Reduces file size for large exports.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before starting export. Allows Zuora data replication to complete. When numeric, must be 0-60. Supports Liquid templating. Default waits 60 seconds.

fields.title: ExportTaskFields
fields.description: Fields to export. Format: {"ObjectName": {"FieldName": "true"}} for simple fields. Use aggregate function names instead of "true" for aggregation. Server-side validation: must have at least 1 field selected.

encrypt.description: When true, encrypts the export file using tenant PGP encryption settings.

where_clause.description: Export ZOQL clauses (without WHERE keyword). Can include: filter conditions, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT - in that order. Supports relative dates (today, now - 7). Supports Liquid templating. GROUP BY max 5 fields. Cannot use aliases in ORDER BY/HAVING.

zero_result_stop.description: When true, it does not continue after this task if export returns no results. When false, it continues with empty file. In most cases, you should set this to true.

strict_variables.description: When true, undefined Liquid variables cause task failure.

disable_validation.description: When true, skips ZOQL validation during workflow setup.

delete_payload_paths.description: JSON paths to remove from workflow Data after task execution.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Export`` for this schema.

file/bulk_data_loader.title: Bulk Data Loader Task
file/bulk_data_loader.description: Submits a bulk data import/update/delete job via Zuora Bulk Data API. Polls for completion. Requires an input file on the task object field.

object.description: Input file reference from Data.Files or workflow file field.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``File::BulkDataLoader`` for this schema.

objectType.description: Zuora object type (e.g. Account, Subscription, namespace__Object).

target.description: Target Zuora field or Liquid expression.

rowIdHeader.description: Optional row ID header column name.

hasHeaders.description: Whether input file has header row.

headers.description: Manual header names when hasHeaders is false.

file/custom_pdf/custom_document.title: Custom PDF Document Task
file/custom_pdf/custom_document.description: Generates custom PDF documents from HTML templates. Converts HTML to PDF with configurable paper size, margins, headers, and footers. Optionally generates DOCX. Output files stored in Data.Files.

template.description: HTML template content for the document. Supports Liquid templates for dynamic content.

header_template.description: HTML template for page header. Supports Liquid templates.

footer_template.description: HTML template for page footer. Supports Liquid templates.

skip_pdf_generate.description: When true, only generates HTML file without PDF conversion.

generate_docx.description: When true, also generates DOCX file alongside PDF.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``File::CustomPDF::CustomDocument`` for this schema.

file/download_file.title: File Download Task
file/download_file.description: Downloads files from Zuora (by file ID) or external URLs. Output stored at Data.Files for use in Iterate, Email, or Upload tasks.

source.description: Download source. 'zuora' for Zuora file IDs, 'external' for HTTP/HTTPS URLs.

file_id.description: Zuora file ID to download. Required when source='zuora'. Supports Liquid templating.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL to download from. Required when source='external'. Supports Liquid templating.

filename.description: Output filename. If blank, uses filename from URL or Content-Disposition header. Supports Liquid.

include_timestamp.description: When true, appends timestamp to filename. Only for source='zuora'.

authorization.title: FileDownloadTaskAuthorization
authorization.description: Authentication for external URLs. Use manual auth types with credential namespaces below, or saved_provider:<uuid> to reference a provider from Settings → Authentication Providers.

oneOf.description: Manual authentication method for external downloads.

Reference to a saved authentication provider from Settings → Authentication Providers. Format: saved_provider:<provider_id>. Credentials are loaded at runtime. List providers via GET /api/v1/auth_providers.

type.description: Authentication method. Only applies when source='external'. saved_provider:<uuid> loads credentials from Settings at runtime.

basic_auth.title: FileDownloadTaskBasicAuth
basic_auth.description: Basic auth credentials for external downloads. Required when authorization.type is 'basic_auth'. Omit when using saved_provider.

oauth2.title: FileDownloadTaskOauth2
oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration for external downloads. Omit when using saved_provider.

oauth1.title: FileDownloadTaskOauth1
oauth1.description: OAuth 1.0 configuration for external downloads. Omit when using saved_provider.

netsuite_tba.title: FileDownloadTaskNetsuiteTba
netsuite_tba.description: NetSuite TBA configuration for external downloads. Omit when using saved_provider.

hmac.title: FileDownloadTaskHmac
hmac.description: HMAC signing configuration for external downloads. Omit when using saved_provider.

skip_ssl_cert_verification.description: When true, skips SSL certificate verification for external downloads.

include_cert.description: When true, includes client certificates for external downloads.

enable_mtls.description: When true, enables mutual TLS for external downloads.

include_extra_certs.description: When true, includes extra SSL certificates for external downloads.

include_p12.description: When true, includes P12 certificate file for external downloads.

force_new_token.description: When true, forces generation of a new authentication token for external downloads.

body_type.description: Request body type for POST/PUT methods.

form_datas.description: Form data key-value pairs for form-data body type.

files.description: Files from Data.Files to include in form-data request.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``File::DownloadFile`` for this schema.

file/file_operations.title: File Operations Task
file/file_operations.description: Performs various file operations: Zip/Unzip files, PGP encryption/decryption, CSV merging of multiple CSV files, PDF creation from binary content, multi-file zipping by regex, and XML attachment to PDF. Output files stored in Data.Files.

object.description: Input file from Data.Files (required for Zip, Unzip, FileEncryption, FileDecryption, AttachXMLtoPDF actions).

action.description: File operation to perform. Zip: compress file. Unzip: extract from zip. FileEncryption/Decryption: PGP operations. CSVCreation: merge CSVs. PDFCreation: create PDF from binary content. ZipFiles: zip multiple by regex. AttachXMLtoPDF: embed XML in PDF.

public_key.description: PGP public key for encryption (FileEncryption action). Supports Liquid templates for key stored in workflow data.

private_key.description: PGP private key for decryption (FileDecryption action). Supports Liquid templates.

passphrase.description: Passphrase for PGP private key (FileDecryption action). Supports Liquid templates.

signer.description: Signer email/ID for signed encryption (FileEncryption action). Creates signed+encrypted output.

signer_passphrase.description: Passphrase for signer private key (FileEncryption action). Supports Liquid templates.

signer_private_key.description: Signer's PGP private key for signing (FileEncryption action). Supports Liquid templates.

signer_public_key.description: Signer's PGP public key for signature verification (FileDecryption action). Supports Liquid templates.

encrypted_filename.description: Output filename for encrypted file (without extension, .pgp added). Supports Liquid templates.

decrypted_filename.description: Output filename for decrypted file (without extension). Supports Liquid templates.

field_name.description: Column headers for output CSV (CSVCreation action). Must be unique, non-empty strings.

columns.title: FileOperationsTaskColumns
columns.description: Column mapping for CSV creation. Keys are input file indices ('1', '2'), values are arrays of 1-based column indices to pull from that file.

csv_filename.description: Output CSV filename without extension (CSVCreation action). Supports Liquid templates.

pdf_content.description: Binary PDF content or base64 encoded string (PDFCreation action). Supports Liquid templates.

pdf_filename.description: Output PDF filename without extension (PDFCreation action). Supports Liquid templates.

filename_regex.description: Regex pattern to match files for zipping (ZipFiles action). Matches against filenames in workflow S3 storage.

zipped_filename.description: Output zip filename without extension (ZipFiles action). Supports Liquid templates.

xml_file.description: XML file from Data.Files to attach to PDF (AttachXMLtoPDF action).

attached_filename.description: Display name for attached XML within PDF (AttachXMLtoPDF action). Supports Liquid templates.

strict_variables.description: When true, undefined Liquid variables cause task failure.

disable_validation.description: When true, skips validation during workflow setup.

delete_payload_paths.description: JSON paths to remove from Data after execution.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``File::FileOperations`` for this schema.

file/zuora_import.title: File Zuora Import Task
file/zuora_import.description: Imports data into Zuora using the bulk/mass action API. Reads CSV from Data.Files and outputs success/error result files. Supports revenue schedule, accounting code, and FX rate imports.

object.description: Filename from Data.Files to import. Must be a CSV file with appropriate columns for the action type.

action.description: Import action type. Determines required CSV columns and Zuora API endpoint.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``File::ZuoraImport`` for this schema.

graph_query.title: GraphQL Query Task
graph_query.description: Executes GraphQL queries against Zuora Object Query API for hierarchical data. Best for single record with nested related objects (e.g., Account with Subscriptions with RatePlans). Returns nested structure - no need for JOINs. Limit: max 200 records per related collection. Output stored at Data.<placement>.<baseObject>. Use Query for simple single-object queries; Export for bulk data or aggregations.

query.description: GraphQL query string. Must be valid GraphQL syntax. Supports Liquid templating. Server-side validation: parsed as valid GraphQL syntax.

variables.description: JSON string of GraphQL variables. Supports Liquid templating. Must be valid JSON. Server-side validation: parsed as valid JSON.

baseObject.description: Primary Zuora object type (lowercase). Used as root key in output. Server-side validation: must be non-empty string.

baseObjectID.description: ID of the base object. Supports Liquid templating. Used for object property. Server-side validation: required when baseObject provided.

querySelection.description: JSON string defining query structure and field selections. Used by UI for query builder. Server-side validation: parsed as valid JSON.

placement.description: Custom key for storing results in Data. If empty, uses baseObject value. Only alphanumeric chars kept.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``GraphQuery`` for this schema.

if.title: If Task
if.description: Conditional branching task. Evaluates a Liquid expression that must output 'true' or 'false' (case-insensitive). Routes workflow to 'True' or 'False' linkages based on result. For multiple conditions with different actions, use Logic::Case instead.

if_clause.description: Liquid expression that must evaluate to 'true' or 'false' (case-insensitive). Use Liquid {% if %} blocks to perform comparisons. Any other output causes task failure.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``If`` for this schema.

invoice_generate.title: Invoice Generate Task
invoice_generate.description: Generates invoices for a Zuora account or subscription. Supports SOAP (generate call) and REST (billing-documents/generate). Output stored at Data.Invoice, and for REST also Data.CreditMemo. SOAP has a 2-minute timeout; for large accounts use Bill Run task instead.

object_id.description: ID of the account or subscription to generate invoices for. Supports Liquid templating.

fields.title: InvoiceGenerateTaskFields
fields.description: Invoice generation parameters. Structure varies by call_type.

InvoiceDate.description: Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for SOAP. Supports Liquid.

TargetDate.description: Target date for billing through (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for SOAP. Supports Liquid.

IgnoreBlankInvoices.description: When true, suppresses error if no charges are due. SOAP only.

AutoPost.description: Automatically post generated invoices. REST only.

AutoRenew.description: Auto-renew subscriptions if needed. REST only.

EffectiveDate.description: Effective date for billing (YYYY-MM-DD). REST only. Supports Liquid.

SubscriptionIds.description: Comma-separated subscription IDs to bill. REST only. Empty = all subscriptions.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``InvoiceGenerate`` for this schema.

iterate.title: Iterate Task
iterate.description: Loops over arrays or file rows, executing child tasks for each item. Supports three modes: Liquid expression (object='CUSTOM LIQUID'), query results (object=array name from Data), or file iteration (object=filename from Data.Files). Child tasks access current item via Data.<ObjectName>. Iteration is AUTOMATIC - do not create linkages back to Iterate. 'For Each' linkage processes per item; 'Complete' linkage (optional) runs after all iterations.

object.description: Iteration source. Use 'CUSTOM LIQUID' for Liquid-based iteration with liquid_statement parameter. Use array name (e.g., 'Account') to iterate Data.Account results. Use filename from Data.Files for file-based iteration.

liquid_statement.description: Required when object='CUSTOM LIQUID'. Liquid expression that returns an array to iterate. Must reference a Data path directly and output JSON array format using | to_json filter.

file_type.description: File format for file-based iteration. CSV for comma/delimiter-separated files. FIXED for fixed-width column files.

skip_headers.description: Number of header rows to skip at start of file. When numeric, max is 25. Use '0' for files with normal column headers or '1' for files with an extra header row. Supports Liquid templating.

skip_trailer.description: When true, skips the last row of the file (useful for files with trailer/summary rows).

csv_header_filter.description: Filter expression applied to CSV headers.

generate_auto_headers.description: When true, generates column headers (Column1, Column2, etc.) for files without headers.

encoding.description: File encoding for reading files (e.g., 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1'). Leave empty for default encoding.

iteration_type.description: Default processes each item individually. Unique-Field de-duplicates by iteration_field, processing first occurrence only. Server-side validation: if set to 'Unique-Field', iteration_field is required.

iteration_field.description: Field name for de-duplication when iteration_type='Unique-Field'. Items with same field value are processed once. Server-side validation: required if iteration_type='Unique-Field'.

chunk_size.description: Process items in batches of this size. '0' processes all items individually (no chunking).

delimiter.description: Field delimiter for CSV file parsing. Default is comma. Use '|' or '\t' for other delimiters.

input_constants_form.description: Configuration for fixed-width file column parsing.

skip_from_beginning.description: Alternative name for skip_headers parameter (deprecated, use skip_headers).

skip_from_bottom.description: Alternative name for skip_trailer parameter (deprecated, use skip_trailer).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Iterate`` for this schema.

linkage.title: Task Linkage
linkage.description: Defines a connection between tasks or from workflow start to a task. Linkages determine execution flow and conditional branching. Each linkage represents a directed edge in the workflow DAG.

source_workflow_id.description: ID of source workflow (for Start linkages only). Indicates this is a workflow entry point. Use this OR source_task_id, never both.

source_task_id.description: ID of source task. Null for Start linkages that connect from workflow entry point. Must be a valid task ID when connecting tasks.

target_task_id.description: ID of the target task this linkage points to. The task that executes when this linkage condition is met.

linkage_type.description: Type of connection determining when target task executes. Different task types support different linkage types. Values: 'Start', 'Success', 'Failure', 'True', 'False', 'For Each', 'Complete', 'Approve', 'Reject', 'Case_<N>', 'Case_Else', 'Page:<route>', 'Upload', 'Timeout', or event names for event-triggered workflows.

logic/case.title: Logic Case Task
logic/case.description: Multi-branch conditional routing based on evaluating a Liquid expression. Routes to the first matching Case_N linkage, or Case_Else if no match.

case_clause.description: REQUIRED. Liquid expression that outputs a value to match against case_condition values. This is the field being evaluated. The output is trimmed before matching. Use {{Data.FieldName}} syntax to reference workflow data. Server-side validation: parsed as valid Liquid template; output must be non-empty string.

case_condition.title: LogicCaseTaskCasecondition
case_condition.description: REQUIRED. Object mapping Case_N keys to match values. Keys MUST be Case_1, Case_2, Case_3, etc. Values are strings or regex patterns that will be matched against the case_clause output. Each key becomes a linkage type for routing. Server-side validation: keys must match Case_N pattern; at least one case required. If disable_regex=false, values validated as regex patterns.

additionalProperties.description: String or regex pattern to match against case_clause output

disable_regex.description: When true, uses exact string matching. When false (default), case values are regex patterns. Set to true for simple value matching. Server-side validation: if false, case_condition values compiled as regex patterns.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::Case`` for this schema.

logic/csv_translator.title: Logic CSV Translator Task
logic/csv_translator.description: Processes CSV files with multiple operations: Filter rows by column value, convert to JSON/XML format, or merge multiple CSVs into one. Reads from Data.Files and outputs to Data or Data.Files.

object.description: File reference from Data.Files to process (required for Filter, xml, to_json actions). Example: 'Export__12345.csv.zip'

action.description: Operation to perform. 'Filter' filters rows, 'xml' converts to XML, 'to_json' converts to JSON, 'merge' combines multiple CSVs.

Column.description: Column name to filter by (Filter action). Mutually exclusive with column_number.

column_number.description: Column index (1-based) to filter by (Filter action). Mutually exclusive with Column.

Value.description: Value to match for filtering (Filter action). Supports Liquid templates and regex if filter_regex=true.

filter_regex.description: When true, treats Value as a regex pattern for matching.

OutputFormat.description: Output format for Filter action. JSON stores in Data, CSV/CSV.ZIP creates file.

placement.description: Object name in Data for JSON output (Filter/to_json actions). Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

files.title: LogicCsvTranslatorTaskFiles
files.description: Files to merge (merge action). Map of file keys to selection/ordering. Example: {'Export__123.csv': {'selected': true, 'order_index': '1'}}

csv_filename.description: Output filename for merged CSV (merge action). Supports Liquid templates.

zero_result_stop.description: When true, stops workflow (no Success linkage) if filtering produces empty result.

replace_payload.description: When true, replaces existing data at placement path (to_json action).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::CSVTranslator`` for this schema.

logic/json_transform.title: Logic JSON Transform Task
logic/json_transform.description: Transforms JSON data using multiple processors: JSONata expressions, Liquid templates, or converts workflow data to CSV/XML file format. Powerful data manipulation for reshaping workflow data.

processor.description: Transformation processor. JSONata for queries/transforms, liquid for templating, xml/csv for file generation.

template.description: Transformation template or expression. For JSONata: JSONata query. For Liquid: template outputting JSON. Required for JSONata/liquid.

version.description: Processor version. JSONata: 1.8.1/1.8.6/2.0.2. XML: 1.0/2.0. Supports Liquid templates.

placement.description: Object name in Data for storing result (JSONata/liquid processors).

replace_payload.description: When true, replaces existing data at placement path.

data_source.description: Data path for xml processor. Examples: 'Data.QueryResults', '{{ Data.Accounts | to_json }}'.

RootElement.description: Root XML element name (xml processor). Supports Liquid templates.

liquid_statement.description: Liquid template outputting JSON array for CSV generation (csv processor). Each array item becomes a row.

csv_headers.description: CSV column headers (csv processor). JSON object mapping source keys to header names, or blank to use object keys.

csv_filename.description: Output CSV filename without extension (csv processor). Supports Liquid templates.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::JSONTransform`` for this schema.

logic/lambda.title: Logic Lambda Task
logic/lambda.description: Invokes an AWS Lambda function with workflow data context. Supports sync (up to 4 min) and async (up to 10 min) execution modes. Lambda receives Data, Credentials, TaskInstance, WorkflowInstance, and GlobalConstants.

LambdaFunction.description: Name of the Lambda function to invoke (without WF- prefix). Function must be owned by the tenant's organization. Either LambdaFunction (for existing) OR FunctionName (for new upload) required.

async_invoke.description: When true, invokes asynchronously (fire-and-forget with callback). Requires tenant-level async_lambda setting enabled. Server-side validation: TimeOut vs TimeOutAsync requirements depend on this flag.

FunctionName.description: Name for new Lambda function (when uploading new function). Required when creating new function.

Handler.description: Lambda handler (e.g., 'index.handler' for Node.js). Required when uploading. Format: module.function_name.

Runtime.description: Lambda runtime environment. Required when uploading. Supported: Node.js 12-18, Python 3.7-3.10, Java 8/11/17, .NET Core 3.1/.NET 5-7, Go 1.x, Ruby 2.7.

Memory.description: Lambda memory in MB (128-10240). Required when uploading. Server-side validation: must be integer between 128 and 10240.

TimeOut.description: Sync execution timeout in seconds (max 240). Required when uploading sync function (async_invoke=false). Server-side validation: must be integer <= 240.

TimeOutAsync.description: Async execution timeout in seconds (max 600). Required when uploading async function (async_invoke=true). Server-side validation: must be integer <= 600.

Description.description: Lambda function description. Optional when uploading.

env_var.description: Environment variables for Lambda function. Optional when uploading. Each entry must have env_key and env_val.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::Lambda`` for this schema.

logic/liquid.title: Logic Liquid Task
logic/liquid.description: Executes Liquid template code for data manipulation and variable assignment. Use {% assign %} to set values in workflow Data context. No explicit output - modifies Data directly.

code.description: Liquid code to execute. Use {% assign %} for setting variables, {% capture %} for complex strings, and standard Liquid filters for transformations. Common filters: | to_json, | size, | default, | date, | map, | where, | sum, | first, | last, | join, | split, | upcase, | downcase, | replace. Server-side validation: parsed as valid Liquid syntax.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::Liquid`` for this schema.

logic/merge.title: Logic Merge Task
logic/merge.description: Merges multiple parallel workflow branches back into a single flow. Waits for all incoming branches to complete before proceeding. Combines data from all branch endpoints into unified workflow data. Data merging rules: Workflow/Files/Liquid objects are merged. Hashes with same key become arrays. Arrays are concatenated. Scalars with same key become arrays.

merge_paths.description: Auto-calculated array of task ID paths leading to this merge point. Each inner array represents one branch path. Example: [[41925, 41926], [41943]] means two branches. Do not manually set this value. Server-side validation: auto-populated during workflow parsing.

merge_start.description: Auto-calculated starting point where branches diverge. 'workflow' for workflow start, or task ID string for branch point. Do not manually set this value. Server-side validation: auto-populated during workflow parsing.

merge_task_ids.description: Auto-calculated task IDs that feed into this merge. Server-side validation: auto-populated during workflow parsing.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Logic::Merge`` for this schema.

logic/response_formatter.title: Logic Response Formatter Task
logic/response_formatter.description: Formats the final workflow response for synchronous/polling callers. Required for Execute::WorkflowTask with enable_polling. template.description: XSLT template for transformation (required for to_xml mode). Must include xsl:output with method attribute. Server-side validation: parsed as valid XSLT when mode='to_xml'.

filename.description: Output filename without extension (to_xml mode). Extension determined by XSLT output method. Supports Liquid templates. Server-side validation: required when mode='to_xml'.

xsd_input.description: XSD schema for validating XML output (to_xml mode only). Supports Liquid templates. Server-side validation: parsed as valid XSD when provided.

action.description: Payment run action. 'create' starts new run, 'update' modifies scheduled run, 'get' retrieves status, 'delete' removes run.

mode.description: Payment collection mode for 'create' action. 'single' for one account, 'adhoc' for batch/BCD filtering, 'file_data' for CSV/JSON input file.

AccountId.description: Account ID for single mode. Supports Liquid templates.

PaymentRunId.description: Payment run ID for get/update/delete actions. Supports Liquid templates.

TargetDate.description: Target date for payment run (YYYY-MM-DD). Invoices with due date on or before this date are collected. Mutually exclusive with RunDate. Supports Liquid templates.

RunDate.description: Scheduled run date (YYYY-MM-DD). For scheduling future payment runs. Mutually exclusive with TargetDate. Supports Liquid templates.

Batch.description: Batch filter for adhoc mode. 'AllBatches' for all accounts, or specific batch name (Batch1-Batch50).

BillCycleDay.description: Bill cycle day filter for adhoc mode. 'AllBillCycleDays' or specific day (1-31).

Currency.description: Currency filter for adhoc mode. Limits payment run to accounts with this currency. Supports Liquid templates.

BillingRunId.description: Billing run ID to collect payments for (adhoc mode). Links payment run to specific bill run. Supports Liquid templates.

PaymentGatewayId.description: Payment gateway to use (adhoc mode). Overrides account default gateway. Supports Liquid templates.

InputFile.description: Input file from Data.Files for file_data mode. CSV or JSON with accountId (required), amount, documentId, etc.

ApplyCreditBalance.description: When true, applies account credit balance before collecting payment from payment method.

CollectPayment.description: When true, collects payment from payment method. Set false to only apply credit balance.

ConsolidatedPayment.description: When true, consolidates multiple invoices into single payment transaction.

AutoApplyCreditMemo.description: When true, auto-applies available credit memos to invoices. Requires Invoice Settlement feature.

AutoApplyUnappliedPayment.description: When true, auto-applies unapplied payments to invoices. Requires Invoice Settlement feature.

ProcessPaymentWithClosedPM.description: When true, processes payments even when payment method is closed/expired.

UseCustomPaymentMethods.description: When true, uses paymentMethodId from input file instead of account default.

retry_on_timeout.description: When true, automatically retries if API timeout occurs during payment run creation.

query.title: Query Task
query.description: Queries Zuora objects using standard ZOQL (Zuora Object Query Language) via SOAP API. Results stored in Data.<object> array. CRITICAL: Hard limit of 2000 records - task FAILS if exactly 2000 returned. Use Export for large datasets. ZOQL LIMITATIONS: Single object only (no joins), no ORDER BY, no GROUP BY/HAVING, results in arbitrary order. For sorting, grouping, or joins, use Export task with Export ZOQL instead.

object.description: The single Zuora object to query. ZOQL can only query ONE object per task (no joins). Determines the ZOQL FROM clause and storage location in Data context.

fields.title: QueryTaskFields
fields.description: Fields to select from the SINGLE object. Structure: {"ObjectName": {"FieldName": "true"}}. ObjectName must match the object property. Cannot select fields from related objects (use Export for joins). IMPORTANT: At least 1 field must be selected (checked at server during setup validation).

where_clause.description: ZOQL WHERE clause (without WHERE keyword). Supports: =, !=, <, >, <=, >=, AND, OR, NOT, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL. Use single quotes for strings. Supports Liquid templating. NO ORDER BY allowed in this clause.

placement.description: Custom key name for storing results in Data object. If empty, results stored at Data.<object>. Only alphanumeric characters are kept.

batch_size.description: Maximum records per SOAP query batch. Supports Liquid templating. When numeric, must be 1-2000.

zero_query_proceed.description: When false (default), it does not continue when the query returns no records. When true, it continues even if query returns no records. In most cases, you should set this to false.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Query`` for this schema.
