options.description: Processing options for billing and payments.

targetDate.description: Target date for billing (YYYY-MM-DD). Supports Liquid.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Suspend`` for this schema.

task_definition.title: General Task Schema
task_definition.description: Base schema for all workflow tasks. All task-specific schemas extend this schema via allOf reference. These fields are available on every task type and control identification, execution priority, and visual positioning in the workflow canvas.

id.description: Integer ID used for task linkage mapping during import/export. This ID is temporary and used only to establish relationships between tasks (via linkage.json). On import, Rails generates new database IDs and updates all linkage references accordingly. When creating workflows, use sequential integers starting from 1.

name.description: Display name of the task shown in the workflow canvas UI. Supports Liquid templating for dynamic names. Best practice: use descriptive names that indicate the task's purpose.

action_type.description: Specifies which task handler processes this task. Each action_type corresponds to a specific task schema (e.g., 'Query' uses query.json, 'Data::Aqua' uses data/aqua.json). The action_type determines what parameters are available and how the task executes.

priority.description: Execution priority affecting task scheduling order. 'High' priority tasks are scheduled before 'Medium' and 'Low' when multiple tasks are ready to execute. Use 'High' for time-sensitive operations, 'Low' for background/cleanup tasks.

css.title: GeneralTaskSchemaCss
css.description: Visual positioning for the task node on the workflow canvas editor. Values are CSS pixel strings. Tasks should be spaced ~150-200px apart for readability. The canvas origin (0,0) is top-left.

top.description: Vertical position from canvas top in pixels (e.g., '100px'). Increase for lower placement.

left.description: Horizontal position from canvas left in pixels (e.g., '200px'). Increase for rightward placement.

call_type.description: API protocol for Zuora API calls. SOAP uses Zuora SOAP API, REST uses Zuora REST API. Not all tasks support both.

concurrent_limit.description: Maximum concurrent executions of this task. Limits parallel processing for rate-limited APIs or resource-intensive operations. Valid range: 1-9999999.

tags.description: Task-level tags for categorization. These are separate from workflow_tags in parameters.

zuora_org_id.description: Zuora organization ID for multi-org tenant environments. When set, the task executes in the context of this specific org. Supports Liquid templating to dynamically select org based on workflow data. Use null or omit for single-org tenants or to inherit from workflow context.

zuora_org_ids.description: Array of Zuora organization IDs for tasks that operate across multiple orgs in multi-org tenant environments. Each string can be a literal org ID or Liquid template expression. Empty array indicates single-org operation.

liquidTemplating.description: String fields in task schemas support Liquid templating. Syntax: {{variable}} for output, {% if %}...{% endif %} for conditionals, {% for %}...{% endfor %} for loops. Common filters: | to_json, | size, | default, | date. Available Liquid context variables: Data, WorkflowInstance, WorkflowSetup, TaskInstance, Credentials, GlobalConstants (see definitions below).

liquidWorkflowInstance.description:
Liquid variable: WorkflowInstance. Runtime information about the current workflow execution.

Fields:
- basic: id, name, status, run_time, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at, external_track_id, api_call_time
- taskCounts: TotalTaskCount, QueuedTaskCount, ProcessingTaskCount, PendingTaskCount, StoppedTaskCount, SuccessTaskCount, ErrorTaskCount
- taskArrays: PendingTasks, ErrorTasks, SuccessTasks (each returns up to 15 TaskInstance objects)
- messages: PendingMessages, ErrorMessages (arrays of error strings)
- navigation: LastExecution (WorkflowInstance of previous run)

liquidWorkflowSetup.description:
Liquid variable: WorkflowSetup. Information about the workflow definition (not the running instance).

Fields:
- id (definition ID), name (definition name)

liquidTaskInstance.description:
Liquid variable: TaskInstance. Information about the current task being executed.

Fields:
- id, name, iterate_row_reference, created_at, updated_at, start_time, original_task_id, status, error, data, error_details, error_class
- navigation: previous_task (TaskInstance of prior task)

liquidCredentials.description:
Liquid variable: Credentials. API authentication. Access via Credentials.zuora.

Fields:
- common: entity_id, rest_endpoint, url, session (SOAP), bearer_token (OAuth), new_session (force refresh)
- basicAuthOnly: username, password (not available for OAuth)
- oauthOnly: client_id, client_secret (not available for Basic auth)

liquidGlobalConstants.description: Liquid variable: GlobalConstants. Tenant-level key-value pairs configured in application settings. Shared across all workflows. Access by key name.

ui/page.title: UI Page Task
ui/page.description: Displays an interactive custom UI page with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Pauses workflow until user submits via custom routes. Supports making authenticated Zuora API calls from the page. For UI-mode workflows only.

html_code.description: HTML content for the page body. Supports Liquid templates when parse_liquid=true. Rendered inside Zuora UI iframe. Server-side validation: sanitized for XSS prevention; script tags and event handlers validated.

stylesheet_code.description: CSS styles for the page. Supports Liquid templates when parse_liquid=true. Server-side validation: scoped to iframe; external imports may be blocked.

javascript_code.description: JavaScript code for the page. Has access to _zuora_endpoint for API calls and _submitRoute for navigation. Supports Liquid templates when parse_liquid=true. Server-side validation: restricted to iframe scope; external API calls authenticated via _zuora_endpoint.

parse_liquid.description: When true, processes Liquid templates in HTML/CSS/JS before rendering. Set to false for static pages or to avoid Liquid conflicts with JavaScript.

route.description: Custom route names for navigation actions. Each route creates a linkage type 'Page:<route>'. Call _submitRoute('<route>') from JavaScript to trigger. Server-side validation: route names must be alphanumeric with underscores.

page_id.description: Optional page identifier for tracking and analytics.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``UI::Page`` for this schema.

ui/stop.title: UI Stop Task
ui/stop.description: Stops a UI-mode workflow execution. Sends stop signal to the custom UI channel, ending the interactive session. Used as terminal task in UI workflows.

redirection_path.description: Optional path to redirect UI after stop signal. Server-side validation: must be valid URL path or Liquid template that resolves to URL.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``UI::Stop`` for this schema.

ui/web_share.title: UI Web Share Task
ui/web_share.description: Creates a shareable web page with custom HTML content and callback routes. Generates JWT-secured URLs for external user interaction. Pauses workflow until user submits via callback or timeout. Results stored in Data.WebContent and Data.UserContent.

html_code.description: HTML content for the web page. Supports Liquid templates when parse_liquid=true. Should include form elements for user input. Server-side validation: sanitized for XSS prevention; JWT authentication embedded in generated URL.

parse_liquid.description: When true, processes Liquid templates in html_code before rendering.

route.description: Custom route names for callback actions. Creates linkage types 'Webshare:<route>'. Example: ['approve', 'reject'] creates linkages for each. Server-side validation: route names must be alphanumeric with underscores.

timeout.title: UiWebShareTaskTimeout
timeout.description: Timeout configuration for web share link expiration. After timeout elapses, 'Timeout' linkage fires or task errors. Server-side validation: total timeout cannot exceed 7 days.

days.description: Days component (1-7). Server-side validation: must be integer 1-7.

hours.description: Hours component (0-23). Server-side validation: must be integer 0-23.

minutes.description: Minutes component (0-59). Server-side validation: must be integer 0-59.

seconds.description: Seconds component (0-59). Server-side validation: must be integer 0-59.

files.title: UiWebShareTaskFiles
files.description: Files to include/reference in the web page. File references from Data.Files.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``UI::WebShare`` for this schema.

update.title: Update Task
update.description: Updates existing Zuora business object records via SOAP API. Supports single record or batch updates using [*] syntax in iteration context.

object.description: The Zuora object type to update.

object_id.description: ID of the record to update. Supports Liquid templating. Use [*] for batch updates in iteration context.

fields.title: UpdateTaskFields
fields.description: Fields to update. Structure: {"<ObjectName>": {"<FieldName>": "<Value>", "fieldsToNull": ["<FieldToNullify>"]}}. Use fieldsToNull array to explicitly set fields to null. IMPORTANT: At least 1 field must be selected in parameters.fields[ObjectName] (checked at server during setup validation).

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Update`` for this schema.

upload/ftp.title: Upload FTP Task
upload/ftp.description: Uploads files from workflow Data.Files to a remote FTP server.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Upload::FTP`` for this schema.

call_type.description: Set to 'FTP' for plain unencrypted FTP.

host.description: FTP server hostname or IP address. Supports Liquid templating.

credentials.title: UploadFtpTaskCredentials
credentials.description: Authentication credentials. Leave blank for anonymous FTP access. The field for the login name is 'username' (not 'login' or 'user').

password.description: FTP password. Store in GlobalConstants for security. Supports Liquid.

folder.description: Remote directory path for uploads. Supports Liquid templating.

ssl_verify.description: SSL certificate verification mode. VERIFY_PEER validates the server certificate (recommended). VERIFY_NONE disables validation (insecure, use only for testing).

files.title: UploadFtpTaskFiles
files.description: Map of files to upload from Data.Files. Keys are filenames in Data.Files.

additionalProperties.title: UploadFtpTaskAdditionalProperties
additionalProperties.description: Per-file upload config. Only 'upload' and 'name' are valid — do NOT use 'target', 'path', or any other field.

upload.description: Must be set to true to upload this file. This field is required.

name.description: Optional new filename on remote server. Supports Liquid templating.

file_ids.description: Zuora file IDs to download from Zuora storage and upload to FTP.

upload/s3.title: Upload S3 Task
upload/s3.description: Uploads files from workflow Data.Files or Zuora file IDs to an S3 bucket. Supports saved S3 authentication providers.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Upload::S3`` for this schema.

s3_provider_id.description: Required. Saved S3 authentication provider ID from Settings → Authentication Providers. Must reference an active provider with auth_type 's3'. List available providers via GET /api/v1/auth_providers (metadata only). Inline AWS credentials are not supported.

path.description: S3 upload path prefix (no leading slash). Supports Liquid.

file_ids.description: Zuora file IDs to download and upload.

files.description: Workflow files from Data.Files to upload.

upload/sftp.title: Upload SFTP Task
upload/sftp.description: Uploads files from workflow Data.Files to a remote SFTP server. Supports password or SSH private key authentication, folder creation, and file renaming.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Upload::SFTP`` for this schema.

host.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address. Supports Liquid templating.

credentials.title: UploadSftpTaskCredentials
credentials.description: Authentication credentials. Use either password (basic auth) or private_key (key-based auth). The field for the login name is 'username' (not 'login' or 'user').

password.description: SFTP password. Store in GlobalConstants for security. Supports Liquid. Required when authorization.type is 'basic'.

private_key.description: SSH private key content (PEM format). Store in GlobalConstants. Supports Liquid. Required when authorization.type is 'key_based'.

passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private_key (if encrypted). Only used with key_based authentication. Store in GlobalConstants. Supports Liquid.

authorization.title: UploadSftpTaskAuthorization
authorization.description: Authentication method selection. 'basic' uses username+password. 'key_based' uses username+private_key (with optional passphrase).

type.description: Authentication type. 'basic' for password authentication, 'key_based' for SSH private key authentication.

folder.description: Remote directory path for uploads. Supports Liquid templating.

create_folder.description: When true, creates the destination folder if it doesn't exist.

permissions.description: Unix file permissions (octal, 100-777) to set on uploaded files. Leave empty for server default.

files.title: UploadSftpTaskFiles
files.description: Map of files to upload from Data.Files. Keys are filenames in Data.Files, values specify upload and optional rename.

additionalProperties.title: UploadSftpTaskAdditionalProperties
additionalProperties.description: Per-file upload config. Only 'upload' and 'name' are valid — do NOT use 'target', 'path', or any other field.

upload.description: Must be set to true to upload this file. This field is required.

name.description: Optional new filename on remote server. Supports Liquid templating.

file_ids.description: Zuora file IDs to download from Zuora storage and upload to SFTP.

usage/import_usage.title: Usage Import Task
usage/import_usage.description: Imports usage records into Zuora from a CSV file. Supports both legacy usage API and Active Rating imports. Polls for completion and generates success/error files. Input file from Data.Files.

object.description: Input CSV file from Data.Files containing usage records. File is uploaded to Zuora for processing.

use_active_rating.description: When true, uses Active Rating usage-imports API (async with validation). When false, uses legacy v1/usage API (simpler format).

description.description: Description for the usage import job. Shows in Zuora usage import history. Supports Liquid templates.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``Usage::ImportUsage`` for this schema.

workflow.title: Workflow Configuration
workflow.description: Configuration for workflow triggers, schedule, parameters, and runtime settings. Defines how the workflow is invoked and its execution behavior.

id.description: Unique identifier for the workflow. Auto-generated on creation.

name.description: Name of the workflow. Must be unique within the tenant.

description.description: Description of the workflow purpose and functionality.

parameters.title: WorkflowConfigurationParameters
parameters.description: Input parameters and event configuration. Contains: input field definitions (accessible as Data.<FieldName>), event_triggers (array of event names), and event_parameters (mapping event fields to Data paths). Internal runtime fields (skipping_check, callout_response, etc.) are omitted from the export when at their default values.

fields.description: Input field definitions accessible as Data.<FieldName> during workflow execution.

event_triggers.description: Array of Zuora event names that trigger this workflow (e.g. 'BillingRunCompletion').

event_parameters.description: Mapping of event fields to Data paths. Each entry specifies eventName and params array.

skipping_check.description: Controls duplicate-run prevention. 'none' disables skipping; other values skip if a run is already pending/running.

merge_task_ids.description: Task IDs whose outputs are merged into the workflow data context on completion.

disable_pending_status.description: When true, workflow runs skip the 'Pending' status and go directly to 'Processing'.

secure_error_msgs.description: When 'true', error messages are sanitized before being returned to callers.

legacy_boolean_input.description: Enable legacy boolean input handling for older workflow versions.

callout_response.description: What to return in the callout HTTP response. 'workflow instance' returns the workflow run object.

file_encryption.description: Encryption key reference for file outputs. null means no encryption.

show_run_prompt.description: When set, displays a prompt dialog before manual workflow runs.

data.title: WorkflowConfigurationData
data.description: Initial data context for the workflow. Merged with incoming parameters on workflow start.

type.description: Internal workflow type. Workflow::Setup is standard workflow definition.

call_type.description: Workflow execution mode determining performance characteristics and available triggers. BATCH for large data (minutes-hours), REALTIME for high concurrency (seconds-minutes), UIACTION for Zuora UI buttons.

ondemand_trigger.description: Enable manual triggering via API (POST /workflows/{id}/run) or UI Run button. Available for BATCH and REALTIME workflows.

callout_trigger.description: Enable triggering by external webhooks via unique workflow callout URL. When enabled, workflow receives callout data in Data context. Not available for BATCH workflows.

scheduled_trigger.description: Enable scheduled execution using cron expression. Requires interval and timezone to be set. Available for BATCH and REALTIME workflows.

interval.description: Cron expression for scheduled workflows (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday). Required when scheduled_trigger is true.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduled workflow execution. Required when scheduled_trigger is true. Determines when cron schedule fires.

event_trigger.description: Enable triggering by Zuora billing events. When true, requires parameters.event_triggers array with event names. Event data available in Data context based on parameters.event_parameters mapping.

status.description: Workflow activation status. Only 'Active' workflows can be triggered. Set to 'Inactive' during development/testing.

css.title: WorkflowConfigurationCss
css.description: CSS positioning for workflow canvas. Contains top/left position of the workflow setup node.

ui_trigger.description: Enable triggering from Zuora UI buttons. Set to true for UIACTION call_type workflows.

notifications.title: WorkflowConfigurationNotifications
notifications.description: Email notification configuration for workflow lifecycle events (start, complete, error).

priority.description: Execution priority. High priority workflows are scheduled before Medium/Low when resources are constrained.

delete_ttl.description: Days to retain workflow run history before automatic deletion. Range: 1-365.

version.description: Semantic version for tracking workflow changes.

zuora_org_id.description: Zuora organization ID for multi-org environments.

ui_pages.title: WorkflowConfigurationUipages
ui_pages.description: UI button configuration for UIACTION workflows. Maps Zuora UI page names to button labels.

solution_id.description: Associated solution ID for marketplace/packaged workflows.

extension_id.description: Associated extension ID for Zuora platform extensions.

zuora_org_ids.description: Array of Zuora organization IDs for multi-org access.

workflow_definition.title: Workflow Definition
workflow_definition.description: Metadata for a workflow definition including name, description, categorization, and access control. This is the top-level container for workflow configuration used in export/import.

name.description: Display name of the workflow definition. Must be unique within tenant. Shown in workflow list and used for identification.

description.description: Description of what the workflow does. Displayed in workflow list, details page, and UI hover tooltips.

category.description: Category to organize workflow definitions in the UI. Workflows are grouped by category in the left navigation.

ui_page_roles.description: User roles that can access UI pages in this workflow. Empty array means all roles can access. Use for role-based access control on interactive workflows.

workflow_export.title: Workflow Export Structure
workflow_export.description: Complete workflow export structure matching Workflow::Setup.export method. Use this schema for importing/exporting complete workflows including all tasks and linkages.

workflow_definition.description: Workflow definition metadata (name, description, category, ui_page_roles). Defines how workflow appears in UI.

workflow.description: Workflow configuration including triggers (on-demand, scheduled, callout, event), execution settings (sync/async, priority), and input parameters.

tasks.description: Array of task definitions. Each task has an 'id' used for linkage mapping (replaced with actual DB IDs on import). See task-specific schemas for parameter details.

id.description: Task ID used for linkage references. Auto-generated, used only within export file.

name.description: Task display name shown in workflow canvas.

action_type.description: Task type identifier. Determines which task schema applies.

parameters.title: WorkflowExportStructureParameters
parameters.description: Task-specific parameters. See individual task schemas for details.

linkages.description: Array of task connections defining workflow execution flow. Linkages use task IDs from the tasks array.

write_off.title: Write Off Task
write_off.description: Writes off invoice balances by creating adjustments. Behavior depends on tenant settings: Invoice Settlement tenants use REST write-off API (creates CreditMemo), others use InvoiceItemAdjustments.

object.description: The Zuora business object type. Use 'Invoice' for write-off operations.

object_id.description: ID of the invoice to write off. Supports Liquid templating.

AdjustmentDate.description: Date for the write-off adjustment (YYYY-MM-DD). Required. Supports Liquid. Server-side validation: cannot be blank.

Comment.description: Comment/note for the adjustment. Supports Liquid.

ReasonCode.description: Reason code for the write-off. Must match configured codes in Zuora.

ChargesOnly.description: When true, only writes off charges (not credits). Non-IS tenants only.

adjust_taxation_items.description: When true, also adjusts tax items. Non-IS tenants only.

single_transaction.description: When true, creates all adjustments in single transaction. Non-IS tenants only.

validate_iia_status.description: When true, only counts 'Processed' adjustments when calculating remaining balance.

action_type.description: Discriminator: identifies this task's handler. Must equal ``WriteOff`` for this schema.

tasks.description: Discriminated union of every supported task type. Variants are keyed by ``properties.action_type.const`` and resolved via the ``action_type`` discriminator.

x-task-index.description: Stable mapping from Zuora action_type to $defs key. Generated for downstream codegen (build_models.py).
